Product:{\"sku\":\"7100104292\"}.name: Resident Evil 7 biohazard Gold Edition
Product:{\"sku\":\"7100104292\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Fear comes home in this highly acclaimed survival horror experience which revitalised the Resident Evil series on its release with its dramatic shift to a first-person viewpoint.

Protagonist Ethan Winters is an ordinary man thrust into extraordinary circumstances as the search for his missing wife leads him to a seemingly abandoned Louisiana house. The horrors that await within its walls will shake you to your core... Powered by Capcom’s RE Engine, Resident Evil 7 delivers an unprecedented level of immersion that brings the thrilling horror up close and personal.

The Gold Edition includes:
- Resident Evil 7 biohazard main game
- Banned Footage Vol.1
- Banned Footage Vol.2
- Not a Hero
- End of Zoe
- Survival Pack DLC (Supply Boxes x 6, Coins x 5, Madhouse difficulty instant unlock)

Note: The Madhouse difficulty level unlock included in the Survival Pack provides instant access to content which is otherwise unlockable by completing the game on any other difficulty level.
